review_notes.note: 昏厥可能預示著危及生命的事件。若伴隨胸痛、呼吸困難、嚴重頭痛、或局部神經功能缺損等警訊症狀，應優先考慮緊急醫療流程，而非僅依賴問卷。此問卷草稿不應用於診斷或取代緊急評估。
目擊者對事件的描述（例如事後是否混亂）對於區分昏厥與癲癇等其他原因至關重要。問卷應考慮納入目擊者觀察的欄位。

rag_sources.title: Syncope: Practice Essentials, Background, Pathophysiology
rag_sources.excerpt: with syncope. Although most causes of syncope are benign, this symptom presages a life-threatening event in a small subset of patients. It is unclear whether hospital inpatient admission of asymptomatic patients after syncope affects outcomes. No current criterion standard exists for diagnosing undifferentiated syncope. Many physicians continue to admit patients because of perceived risk. Reviews of the 2001 American College of Emergency Physician (ACEP) clinical policy suggested that evidence-based criteria may decrease admission rates by nearly half by identifying cardiac causes of syncope.

rag_sources.title: Trichomoniasis: Background, Pathophysiology, Etiology
rag_sources.excerpt: Trichomoniasis is thought to be widely underdiagnosed owing to various factors, including a lack of routine testing, the low sensitivity of a commonly used diagnostic technique (wet mount microscopy), and nonspecific symptomatology. Self-diagnosis and self-treatment or diagnosis by practitioners without adequate laboratory testing may also contribute to misdiagnosis.
